definitions.text_mt: Inkintur jew għeluq magħmul minn vireg, użat biex iżomm għasafar jew annimali żgħar

usage_examples.mt: Poġġejt l-għasfur fil-gaġġa biex ma jaħrabx.
usage_examples.en: I put the bird in the cage so it would not escape.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġar tiegħi għandu gaġġa kbira bit-tjur fil-bitħa.
usage_examples.en: My neighbour has a big hencoop in the backyard.

definitions.text_mt: Pubblikazzjoni ta' aħbarijiet ippubblikata kuljum jew kull ġimgħa

usage_examples.mt: Kull filgħodu jixtri l-gażetta mill-ħanut.
usage_examples.en: Every morning he buys the newspaper from the shop.

usage_examples.mt: Kitbet artiklu għall-gażetta tal-iskola.
usage_examples.en: She wrote an article for the school gazette.

definitions.text_mt: Xarba karbonata u effervexxenti, ħafna drabi bit-togħma

usage_examples.mt: Nixrob il-gażuż meta nkun għaddej mis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: I drink soda water when I am getting through the summer.

usage_examples.mt: Gażuż bil-lumi huwa xarba iġjenika.
usage_examples.en: Lemon soda water is a refreshing drink.

etymology_chain.term: gaggìa or more probably a regional variant of it

definitions.text_mt: Siġra tal-familja Fabaceae, li tagħti dell u fjuri sofor jew bojod

usage_examples.mt: Il-gażżija fil-ġnien tagħti dell sabiħ fis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: The acacia in the garden gives nice shade in the summer.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fjuri tal-gażżija jfarrxu fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The acacia blossoms bloom in spring.

definitions.text_mt: Siġra tax-xewk tal-ġeneru Vachellia karroo, li toriġina mill-Afrika t'Isfel

usage_examples.mt: Il-gażżija tax-xewk tintuża bħala siġra ornamentali fil-ġonna.
usage_examples.en: The sweet thorn is used as an ornamental tree in gardens.

definitions.text_mt: Ġabar flimkien f'munzell jew f'borġ, akkumula

usage_examples.mt: Geddes il-ħatab f'munzell kbir ħdejn in-nar.
usage_examples.en: He heaped up the firewood in a big pile near the fire.

usage_examples.mt: Matul is-snin geddes ġid kbir.
usage_examples.en: Over the years he amassed great wealth.

definitions.text_mt: Il-parti t'isfel tal-wiċċ, taħt il-ħalq
L-għadam li jifforma l-parti t'isfel tal-ħalq

definitions.text_en: snout of a pig or similar animal
definitions.text_mt: L-imnieħer u l-ħalq ta' ħanżir jew annimal simili, li jisporġu 'l barra

usage_examples.mt: Qabdet lil binha minn geddumu u bstuh.
usage_examples.en: She grabbed her son by the chin and kissed him.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħanżir kellu geddumu msebbaħ fit-tajn.
usage_examples.en: The pig had its snout covered in mud.

definitions.text_mt: Mammiferu primat, ħafna drabi b'denb twil u wiċċ espressiv

usage_examples.mt: Rajt gedmejmun jiżfen fiċ-ċirk.
usage_examples.en: I saw a monkey dancing at the circus.

usage_examples.mt: Il-gedmejmun qabeż minn siġra għall-oħra.
usage_examples.en: The monkey jumped from one tree to another.

definitions.text_mt: Tkellem b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, bejn snienu

usage_examples.mt: Gedwed kelma jew tnejn waqt li kien jaqra l-ittra.
usage_examples.en: He mumbled a word or two while reading the letter.

usage_examples.mt: X'qed tgedwed bejnek u bejn ruħek?
usage_examples.en: What are you muttering to yourself?

definitions.text_mt: Annimal li għadu żgħir, speċjalment mammiferu
Għoġol, il-frieħ tal-baqra
Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod immatur jew infantili

usage_examples.mt: Il-gellux qiegħed jirda' mingħand ommu.
usage_examples.en: The calf is suckling from its mother.

usage_examples.mt: Tġibx ruħek bħal gellux, kbir int!
usage_examples.en: Do not behave like an immature person, you are grown up!

definitions.text_mt: Mammiferu kbir tal-familja Bovidae, b'qrun mgħawweġ u ġisem massiċċ

usage_examples.mt: Il-gemus huwa annimal b'saħħtu u jgħix ħdejn ix-xmajjar.
usage_examples.en: The buffalo is a strong animal and lives near rivers.

usage_examples.mt: Il-gemus Amerikan kważi spiċċa fis-seklu dsatax.
usage_examples.en: The American bison almost became extinct in the nineteenth century.

definitions.text_mt: Kostellazzjoni taż-żodjaku li tirrappreżenta barri, viżibbli fis-sema tax-xitwa
It-tieni sinjal taż-żodjaku, assoċjat ma' min imwieled bejn l-20 t'April u l-20 ta' Mejju

usage_examples.mt: Gendus deher ċar fis-sema lbieraħ filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: Taurus was clearly visible in the sky last night.

usage_examples.mt: Jiena twelidt taħt is-sinjal ta' Gendus.
usage_examples.en: I was born under the sign of Taurus.

definitions.text_mt: Irrombla, dawwar oġġett fuq il-wiċċ
Iffinalizza jew spiċċa xi ħaġa b'urġenza jew malajr
Għadda malajr, speċjalment taż-żmien

usage_examples.mt: Gerbeb il-ballun lejn it-tfal fil-bitħa.
usage_examples.en: He rolled the ball towards the children in the yard.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żmien gerbeb malajr waqt il-vaganzi.
usage_examples.en: Time passed quickly during the holidays.

definitions.text_mt: Ħawwad, għamel taħwida f'affarijiet jew informazzjoni
Neħħa l-ordni, poġġa affarijiet f'postijiet ħżiena
Fittex bir-reqqa imma b'mod diżordinat fost l-affarijiet

usage_examples.mt: Gerfext il-karti fuq l-iskrivanija u ma sibt xejn.
usage_examples.en: I mixed up the papers on the desk and could not find anything.

usage_examples.mt: Min gerfex il-kexxun tiegħi?
usage_examples.en: Who rummaged through my drawer?

definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' gerfex, l-att tal-ġerfex jew it-taħwid tal-affarijiet
Stat ta' taħwida jew nuqqas ta' ordni

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-festa kien hemm gerfix kbir fid-dar.
usage_examples.en: After the party there was a great disorder in the house.

definitions.text_mt: Ħaġa li saret ħażin jew imħawda, xogħol imfixkel

usage_examples.mt: Dan il-proġett kollu huwa gerfux.
usage_examples.en: This whole project is a bungled mess.

usage_examples.mt: Min għamel dan il-gerfux irid jibda mill-ġdid.
usage_examples.en: Whoever made this bungle must start over.

definitions.text_mt: Imħawwad jew diżordinat fil-ħsieb jew fl-imġiba, speċjalment wara avveniment stressanti

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-aħbar ħażina, kien gerfuxi għal jiem sħaħ.
usage_examples.en: After the bad news, he was confused for whole days.

usage_examples.mt: Titkellimx miegħu issa, huwa gerfuxi.
usage_examples.en: Do not talk to him now, he is confused.

definitions.text_mt: Esprima nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon b'leħen baxx u storbjuż
Ħareġ ħoss profond u ta' theddida, speċjalment ta' annimal
Ħareġ ħoss baxx u kontinwu, bħal ta' raggħad jew magna
Ħareġ ħoss bħal ta' likwidu li jiċċaqlaq ġo kontenitur

usage_examples.mt: Gerger il-ħin kollu dwar l-ikel.
usage_examples.en: He grumbled all the time about the food.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelb beda jgerger meta ressaqt idejja.
usage_examples.en: The dog started to growl when I moved my hand closer.

usage_examples.mt: L-ilma gerger ġol-borma.
usage_examples.en: The water gurgled inside the pot.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tgerger u tilmenta kontinwament, speċjalment għal raġunijiet żgħar

usage_examples.mt: Huwa gergier maħruq, qatt m'hu kuntent.
usage_examples.en: He is an inveterate grumbler, never satisfied.

usage_examples.mt: Tkellem ma' dak il-gergier u tara kif isib difett f'kollox.
usage_examples.en: Talk to that grumbler and you will see how he finds fault in everything.

definitions.text_mt: Li jitkellem iżżejjed, li ma jieqafx jitkellem

usage_examples.mt: Ir-raġel gergieri dejjem isib lil xi ħadd x'ikellem.
usage_examples.en: The garrulous man always finds someone to talk to.

definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' gerger, l-att ta' tgergir jew ilment kontinwu

usage_examples.mt: Il-gergir tiegħu ddejjaq lil kulħadd fl-uffiċċju.
usage_examples.en: His grumbling annoyed everyone in the office.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tgerger u ma tkun qatt sodisfatta

usage_examples.mt: Gergur bħalu ma jogħġbu xejn fid-dinja.
usage_examples.en: A grumbler like him likes nothing in the world.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu tendenza jitkellem żżejjed u kontinwament

usage_examples.mt: In-nies gergurin dejjem isibu xi ħaġa x'jgħidu.
usage_examples.en: Garrulous people always find something to say.

definitions.text_mt: Beżża' u keċċa 'l bogħod, speċjalment annimali jew persuni mhux mixtieqa

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi gerrex lill-għasafar mir-raba' bil-ħoss.
usage_examples.en: The farmer scared off the birds from the field with noise.

usage_examples.mt: Ommi gerrit il-qtates minn fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: My mother chased the cats off the table.

definitions.text_mt: Tkellem b'mod kontinwu u ħafna drabi bla sens, iċċettja

usage_examples.mt: Gerwel fuq it-telefon għal sigħat sħaħ.
usage_examples.en: He chattered on the phone for hours on end.

usage_examples.mt: Tibqax tgerwel u ejja naħdmu.
usage_examples.en: Stop babbling and let us work.
